verdict.rationale: cubic documents several first-party automations that run unattended once enabled: automatic review of every new PR, auto-fix across every review of a pull request, auto-approval of low-risk PRs, auto-resolving threads, and automatic issue-requirement analysis. These are fixed, event-triggered toggles tied to the PR lifecycle rather than user-defined automations. missing for 10: user-defined automation triggers or workflows, recurring/scheduled background runs (e.g. scheduled codebase scans), and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.
Auto-approval lets you skip human review for pull requests that cubic determines are low risk and issue-free.
Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
cubic can automatically fix issues in the background.
